# @heswell/trading-schemas API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/api-reference.ts from the TypeScript source. Do not edit: run `bun run docs:api`. -->

The client entry of `@heswell/trading-schemas`: table definitions, enums, RPC contracts and validation, tick / lot maths. Shared by the UI, the servers and the in-browser engines. Overview: [schemas.md](../schemas.md), [package README](../../packages/trading-schemas/README.md).

Imports: `@heswell/trading-schemas`. 427 exports. Types are shown as written in the source; defaults come from `@default` tags or the component's destructuring defaults.

#### impliedVol

*function* · [domain/optionMath.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/optionMath.ts#L126)

Implied volatility of a Black-76 price: Newton from a Brenner-Subrahmanyam
start, falling back to bisection. Undefined when the price is outside the
no-arbitrage bounds or there is no time left.

```ts
impliedVol(price: number, inputs: Omit<OptionInputs, "vol">, tolerance = 1e-8): number | undefined
```


#### DAY_MS

*const* · [domain/session.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/session.ts#L12)

Session time and the intraday volume curve, shared by exchange-sim (which
scales bot activity by the curve) and the OMS (whose VWAP strategy follows
the same curve).

"Clock" times are ms since the epoch. "Session" times are the time of day
of the (possibly compressed) trading day: with `dayMs` < 24h a whole
simulated day passes in `dayMs` ms of clock time, so session durations are
scaled by `dayMs / DAY_MS` when converted to clock durations.

```ts
const DAY_MS: 86400000
```

#### EntryMessageLevel

*const* · [domain/entryMessages.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/entryMessages.ts#L19)

Errors and warnings of an orderEntry row, carried in its vuuMsg column as
a JSON array (an empty string when there are none):

  [{"l":"E","f":"price","c":"INVALID_TICK_SIZE","t":"Price must be on a 0.5 tick"}]

- l: level. E = error (blocks sendOrder), R = needs review (sendOrder
  needs confirmed), I = information.
- f: the draft field it is about (an orderEntry column, e.g. price or
  durationMins), or "form" for the order as a whole.
- c: a RejectReason, or a risk code (EntryRiskCode).
- t: the text to show.

vuuMsg is also used by vuu-server for its own plain-text messages
(`stale:<key>:<cols>`); anything that is not a JSON array decodes as a
single form-level error.

```ts
const EntryMessageLevel: Readonly<{ readonly Error: "E"; readonly Review: "R"; readonly Info: "I"; }>
```

#### ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS

*const* · [domain/orderStatus.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/orderStatus.ts#L20)

Allowed OrdStatus transitions, shared by OMS (which enforces them) and UI
(which uses them to decide e.g. whether amend/cancel are offered).

Conventions:
- An order always starts in PENDING_NEW and is acknowledged (NEW) or
  REJECTED before any fill is reported.
- IOC/FOK remainders and DAY orders at session end become EXPIRED.
- A cancel/replace reject returns the order to its working status
  (NEW / PARTIALLY_FILLED / REPLACED).
- Fills may race a pending cancel/replace.
- REPLACED is a working status: the order was amended and remains live.
- FILLED, CANCELLED, REJECTED and EXPIRED are terminal.

This is only the transition table; the full reducer (quantities, exec
reports) lives in the OMS.

```ts
const ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS: Readonly< Record<OrdStatus, readonly OrdStatus[]> >
```

#### OptionInputs

*interface* · [domain/optionMath.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/optionMath.ts#L12)

Black-76 option pricing: European options on a forward. Shared by the
exchange simulator (fair values), the OMS (risk) and the UI (Greeks).

Inputs are the forward (spot carried to expiry), the strike, the years to
expiry and an annualised volatility. `discount` is the discount factor to
expiry (1 = undiscounted, the simulator's default). Greeks are with
respect to the forward; multiply delta and gamma by dF/dS for spot Greeks.

| `forward` | `number` |  |  |

| `years` | `number` |  | Years to expiry; <= 0 prices at intrinsic value. |
| `vol` | `number` |  | Annualised volatility, e.g. 0.25; <= 0 prices at intrinsic value. |
| `discount?` | `number` |  | Discount factor to expiry (default 1). |

#### VolumeProfileParams

*interface* · [domain/session.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/domain/session.ts#L21)

Shape of the intraday volume curve over the continuous session. The
activity multiplier at session fraction f (0 = open, 1 = close) is
`base + curve * (2f - 1)^2 + openSpike * e^(-f/width) + closeSpike * e^(-(1-f)/width)`,
normalised to average 1 over the session.

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | `number` |  |  |
| `curve` | `number` |  | U-shape: extra weight towards both ends of the session. |
| `openSpike` | `number` |  | Extra activity just after the open. |
| `closeSpike` | `number` |  | Extra activity just before the close. |
| `spikeWidth` | `number` |  | Width of the open / close spikes, as a fraction of the session. |

#### RpcName

*const* · [rpc/contracts.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/rpc/contracts.ts#L45)

RPC contracts. All trading RPCs are sent as RPC_REQUEST with
VIEWPORT_CONTEXT (any viewport on a table of the target module) and are
registered server-side with DefaultRpcHandler.registerRpc.

#### setTimeSeriesWindowParams

*const* · [rpc/contracts.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/rpc/contracts.ts#L725)

Open or move a time-series subscription: the M4 buckets of `fields` over
`[start, end)` are published as `timeSeriesBuckets` rows with this
`subId` (a client-chosen id; filter a viewport on it). Bucket width is the
largest base interval × 2^k not wider than `(end - start) / points`, so
about one bucket per point. Like a viewport range change: moving the
window inserts / deletes only the buckets entering / leaving it; a new
width resends all. `follow` slides the window with the live edge (end =
now). Re-send at least every TIME_SERIES_LEASE_MS to keep it open.

```ts
const setTimeSeriesWindowParams: Validator<InferShape<{ subId: Validator<string>; ric: Validator<string>; fields: OptionalValidator<string>; start: Validator<number>; end: Validator<number>; points: Validator<...>; follow: OptionalValidator<...>; }>>
```

#### TimeSeriesData

*interface* · [rpc/contracts.ts](../../packages/trading-schemas/src/rpc/contracts.ts#L687)

One field's samples. Times are delta encoded: `t[0]` is ms after `t0`,
each later `t[i]` ms after `t[i - 1]`. A `null` value is a gap: the line
breaks there (its time is between the points either side).

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `TimeSeriesField` |  |  |
| `t0` | `number` |  |  |
| `t` | `number[]` |  |  |
| `v` | `(number \| null)[]` |  |  |
| `sourcePoints` | `number` |  | Points in the store inside the requested window. |
